user.title: Energy Split
user.description: Configure the cooperative energy accounting for this Home Assistant install. You will be asked for currency, grid meter, optional PV and battery, and the list of tenants.

data_description.currency: Three-letter currency code used as the unit of measurement for all monetary sensors.

data_description.import_energy_entity: A cumulative total-increasing sensor with unit_of_measurement kWh.
data_description.power_entity: Optional; used only for freshness gating.
Optional. Enables live PV cost-rate accounting.
data_description.energy_entity: Optional. Enables cumulative PV energy tracking.

data.power_entity: Battery signed DC power (W, negative on discharge)

data_description.charge_energy_entity: Cumulative total-increasing kWh counter of energy charged into the battery.
data_description.discharge_energy_entity: Cumulative total-increasing kWh counter of energy discharged from the battery.
data_description.power_entity: Signed DC power in W. Negative values indicate discharge.
data_description.charge_efficiency: Round-trip charge efficiency. Values below 50 % or above 100 % are rejected.
data_description.discharge_efficiency: Round-trip discharge efficiency. Values below 50 % or above 100 % are rejected.
data_description.initial_stock_kwh: Priced stock present in the battery at first setup.
data_description.initial_stock_cost: Cost of the initial priced stock in the chosen currency.

data_description.power_entity: Optional. Enables the residual_of_total_minus_others allocation policy for tenants without a direct meter.
data_description.energy_entity: Optional. Reported alongside the power boundary.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: Add at least two tenants. Each tenant has a slug, a display name, an allocation policy, and optionally a direct energy or power meter plus shared loads.

tariff.title: Time-of-use tariff
tariff.description: Configure the tariff schedule. A single day/night preset is offered; you can define custom windows per weekday in the options flow.

error.invalid_currency: Invalid currency code. Use an ISO 4217 three-letter code.
error.invalid_slug: Slugs must be lowercase, ASCII, and kebab-case.
error.invalid_entity: The selected entity does not exist or has an incompatible device class.
error.invalid_unit: The selected entity's unit_of_measurement does not match the expected unit.
error.invalid_schedule: Tariff windows must partition every configured weekday exactly once.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single Energy Split instance can be configured per Home Assistant install.

init.title: Energy Split options
init.description: Add, rename, or remove tenants, change tariffs and currency, or adjust freshness windows.

add_tenant.title: Add a tenant
add_tenant.description: Add a new tenant to the cooperative. The slug is used in entity unique_ids and cannot be renamed later.

data_description.name: Human-visible name shown on the dashboard.
data_description.allocation_policy: How this tenant's accounting load is computed.

rename_tenant.title: Rename a tenant
rename_tenant.description: Pick a tenant to rename. Only the display name changes; the slug is immutable so entity unique_ids stay stable.

rename_tenant_confirm.title: Rename tenant {slug}
rename_tenant_confirm.description: Enter the new display name for tenant {slug}.

remove_tenant.title: Remove a tenant
remove_tenant.description: Pick a tenant to remove. At least two tenants must remain configured.

remove_tenant_confirm.title: Remove tenant {name}
remove_tenant_confirm.description: Confirm removal of tenant {name} ({slug}). This is destructive: the tenant's sensors will disappear on next reload.

freshness.title: Freshness windows
freshness.description: Maximum accepted age (in seconds) for each data class before the corresponding freshness gate flips to off and dependent cost sensors go unavailable.

tariff_edit.title: Edit tariff rate
tariff_edit.description: Append a new rate for a named tariff slot with the current UTC time as effective_from. Historical intervals keep their original rate per invariant I9.

error.invalid_slug: Slugs must be lowercase, ASCII, and kebab-case.
error.duplicate_slug: That slug is already in use.
error.invalid_policy: That allocation policy is not recognised.
error.unknown_slot: That tariff slot is not defined.
error.invalid_rate: Rate must be a non-negative number.

abort.no_tenants: There are no tenants to rename.
abort.unknown_tenant: That tenant no longer exists; the action was aborted.
abort.minimum_tenants: At least two tenants must remain; add a tenant before removing one.

rebuild_period_report.name: Rebuild period report
rebuild_period_report.description: Rebuild a deterministic Recorder-based JSON report for the given period.

start.name: Start (local)
start.description: Local start of the reporting period.

end.name: End (local)
end.description: Local end of the reporting period.

tenant.name: Tenant (optional)
tenant.description: Restrict the report to a single tenant slug.

reset_battery_ledger.name: Reset battery ledger
reset_battery_ledger.description: Reset the priced battery stock to the given values. Requires admin permissions.

stock_cost.name: Stock cost
stock_cost.description: Cost of the new priced stock in the configured currency.

set_tariff_rate.name: Set tariff rate
set_tariff_rate.description: Set the per-kWh rate for a named tariff slot from a given effective_from timestamp forward.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Name of the tariff slot (for example day or night).

rate.name: Rate
rate.description: Per-kWh rate in the configured currency.

effective_from.name: Effective from
effective_from.description: Timestamp from which the new rate applies.

tariff_schedule_invalid.title: Tariff schedule is invalid
tariff_schedule_invalid.description: Energy Split rejected the current tariff schedule: {reason}. Open the integration options to fix it. Until then, cost sensors will remain unavailable per invariant I1.

ledger_boundary_incoherent.title: Battery ledger is incoherent
ledger_boundary_incoherent.description: The persisted battery ledger boundary pair (stock_kwh, stock_cost) is not coherent per invariant I6. Reset it via the `energy_split.reset_battery_ledger` service with a valid pair.

upstream_missing.title: Upstream sensor is missing
upstream_missing.description: The configured sensor {resource} is not present in Home Assistant. Reconfigure the integration to point at the current entity.
